title: How much car can you afford? (Short)

lines.say: How much car can you afford?

scene.label: Max car payment on $60,000
scene.sub: a month, after insurance, gas and upkeep

lines.cap: On $60,000 a year, 10% is $500 a month for everything car-related. After insurance, gas and upkeep, that's a $200 payment.
lines.say: On sixty thousand a year, ten percent is five hundred a month for everything car-related. After insurance, gas and upkeep, that's a two hundred dollar payment.

lines.cap: And watch the long loan. Four years on $30,000: $4,483 in interest.
lines.say: And watch the long loan. Four years on thirty thousand: forty-four eighty-three in interest.
Six years: sixty-eight twenty-six. That's twenty-three forty-three more.
Asked for a monthly payment? Answer with a total price.
